# Welcome to PowerFS Discussions!

> **Pin this post** (maintainers only) so every visitor sees it first.

---

## What is PowerFS?

PowerFS is a Rust-native unified storage system for HPC + AI converged computing. It provides POSIX (FUSE/Kernel), S3, and KV cache interfaces over a single data pool — eliminating the three-stack fragmentation that plagues HPC+AI infrastructure.

## How to Use This Space

| Category | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| 📢 **Announcements** | Releases, important notifications (admin-only) |
| 💬 **Q&A** | Usage questions — **mark the best reply as "Accepted Answer"** to help others |
| 📝 **General** | Project direction, architecture, community chat |
| 🔧 **Development** | Rust/kernel source, PR-related, architecture design |
| 💡 **Feature Requests** | New feature ideas, vote on proposals |

## Rules

1. **Issues are for bugs only.** Usage questions go to **Q&A**.
2. **Search before posting** to avoid duplicates.
3. Prefer **English** for main posts. Chinese is welcome in sub-topics.
4. Be respectful — see our [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/powerfs/powerfs/blob/master/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
5. When someone answers your question, **mark it as Accepted Answer** (the ✅ button).

## Need Help?

1. Check the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/powerfs/powerfs#quick-start)
2. Search existing Q&A discussions
3. If still stuck, post a new question in **Q&A** with:
   - PowerFS version (commit hash or tag)
   - Your config (redact sensitive info)
   - Error messages / logs
   - OS and kernel version
